The threshold graph records QD_lt_2, meaning QD < 2.0 for all variant types [graph#2]. This matches the vendor default [CF-QD:default]. A local SOP / clinic protocol uses QD < 1.5 as an alternative [CF-QD:local], and the decision is pending (V3). The retrieved results do not explain how variant filtering relates to gene panels.
